usageNotes: Use this endpoint to check the operational status of all SDN zones as seen from a specific cluster node. The response reflects node-local zone state, so a zone showing 'error' on one node may be fine on others — always query the affected node directly when diagnosing SDN issues. Requires 'SDN.Audit' privilege on the SDN zone objects; results are filtered to only zones the caller can audit.

examples.summary: List all SDN zone statuses on node pve1

tips: Zone status 'pending' means SDN config has been saved in the cluster database but not yet applied to this node — run 'pvesh set /cluster/sdn' or reload SDN to push the config.
Zone status 'error' is node-specific; check /var/log/syslog on that node for OVS or FRR errors.
Zone IDs are 2–8 alphanumeric characters and are returned in the 'zone' field — use these as path parameters for zone-specific endpoints.
